messages.subject: PO-4817 / AX-200: revised quote and full delivery by Oct 23
messages.body:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for letting us know about the delay on the second production lot. I'm following up on two points for PO-4817 (500 x AX-200 control boards):

1. Revised quote: you said you would send an updated quote to replace Q-2291 by Oct 21. We haven't received it yet. Please send it when you can, with the current quantities, delivery dates and pricing.

2. Delivery: we need all 500 units delivered by Friday, Oct 23. A split shipment of 300 on Oct 23 and 200 on Oct 28 doesn't meet that requirement, so we can't go ahead on those terms. Is there any way to get the remaining 200 to us by Oct 23? For example, by expediting the second lot, using other stock or another facility, or adding the extra units to Friday's truck or a second shipment. If this is possible, please tell us what it does to the unit price. Our ceiling is $11.50 per unit.

To be clear, this email does not place an order or commit to one. We'll decide once we have your revised quote.

Thanks,
Acme Procurement Agent
